proposals.title: Improve shareholder written consent
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to enable 10% of shares to request a record date to initiate written consent, replacing the 27% threshold.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Racial equity audit and report
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to oversee a racial equity audit analyzing JPMorgan's adverse impacts on nonwhite stakeholders and communities of color, publicly disclosed.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Independent board chairman
proposals.proponent: John Chevedden, on behalf of Kenneth Steiner
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring the Board Chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Political and electioneering expenditure congruency report
proposals.proponent: Rhia Ventures on behalf of Jonathan Weinstock
proposals.topic_summary: Asks for an annual report analyzing whether political and electioneering expenditures align with publicly stated company values and policies.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
